biotools.summary: MetaCompare is a bioinformatic pipeline and web service that ranks resistome risks across metagenomic sequencing data, differentiating between human health and ecological risks. It projects samples into a hazard space and calculates risk scores based on antibiotic resistance gene (ARG) mobility.
